target_customer: Outpatient physical therapy clinics, mostly WebPT users in the US
problem: Front desks lose revenue to cancellations, phone tag and unfilled openings. Penciled texts patients, books plans of care and fills cancellations from a waitlist.
business_model: B2B SaaS per therapist seat annually plus $1,200 per location onboarding fee
product_category: AI front office for healthcare clinics

founders.name: Shawn Shivdat
founders.background_notes: Also launched a jobs board product at a health tech startup and founded a global nonprofit, per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs reliable EHR integration (WebPT), HIPAA compliance and conversational scheduling logic.

defensibility.rationale: Native WebPT integration and clinic workflow lock-in help, but many AI receptionist vendors target PT.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found. Rivals such as SPRY launched AI scheduling later.

market_need_then: Front desk staffing and cancellation losses are real in PT; the company reports 14.8 percent more visits and 27 percent fewer calls at one customer (company claims).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident and results focused; speaks to front desk pain

rebrands.why: Not stated; launch post uses somnapp.com and the legal entity is SomnApp, Inc. DBA Penciled

branding.community_and_virality: Customer testimonials on site; no wider community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly real word name that suits scheduling, but no press on the brand and a second name (Somn) in use.

outcome_analysis: Penciled, run by a Harvard trained solo founder with health data experience, claims 200+ providers across 50+ clinics through a WebPT integration. It reports about $2.6M raised from YC, Initialized and healthcare founders. The traction figures are company claims and the company remains active with a two person team on YC's page.
notes: Funding: $2.6M+ total from a company job listing and a yespress profile; recorded as one seed entry though it may be cumulative and date unknown. Dealroom lists a $125K seed, unreconciled. Competitor sources were undated, so list empty. Rebrand entry (Somn to Penciled) is inferred from the launch post and entity name, direction unconfirmed. Team size 2 on YC page conflicts with 200+ provider claim.
